lines.en: Okay, um, this is going to be fun.
Listen, uh, I've been doing some thinking,
and I don't know whether it's because we're here
but, um, I think we should try to have a baby.
Okay, I've been thinking about it, too,
You think we're ready to have a baby now?
You're ready to have a baby?
You said you were ready, too.
Yeah, but I was just screwing with you
to try to get your voice all high and weird
I guess, but haven't you wanted a kid, like, forever?
